title: Cabbage: modeled ₹297/qtl left, Kondotty → Aroor
summary: January 2021: reported cabbage prices at Kondotty and Aroor imply a positive modeled margin after costs on 100% of 22 matched days; a morning-report back-test averages ₹297 per quintal. No actual trade verified.
why_selected: Selected from 608 same-variety market pairs screened for cabbage in January 2021; best tested candidate among the bounded set of routed finalists, not a global optimum.

evidence.observations: daily modal prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) at both markets; sale matched to the first Aroor report 1–3 days after purchase
caveats: Back-test on reported prices: no actual shipment, buyer or seller is claimed.
Modal prices are reported daily aggregates, not offers anyone could be sure to get.
This data has no arrival volumes, so it cannot show whether the destination could absorb more supply; no capital-constrained or volume allocation optimum is claimed.

Costs extrapolate onion survey values (including to other crops) plus stated allowances, not freight quotes; OSRM car routing, not a verified truck route. Representative town points may not be at mandi gates.
Historical: this says what paid then, not what pays today.

scenes.headline: January 2021
scenes.caption: Kondotty (Kerala) and Aroor (Kerala) both reported cabbage prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) on 22 matched days.

scenes.headline: Two markets, two prices
scenes.caption: Kondotty reported a median ₹1,500 per quintal. Aroor reported a median ₹2,100 around modeled arrival days. These are not offers.

scenes.headline: Gap ₹550/qtl
scenes.caption: The median gap was ₹550 per quintal, and Aroor was dearer on 100% of days.

scenes.headline: 177 km by road
scenes.caption: 177 km on OpenStreetMap roads (~3 hours by car). A loaded truck is slower, so we allow 1 days plus 7 days to get paid.

scenes.headline: After modeled costs
scenes.caption: Freight ≈₹38/qtl, 5% fees and commission, loading, 5% loss and interest. On the typical day ₹284 per quintal was left.

scenes.headline: Still positive under stress
scenes.caption: With 25% dearer freight, 10% loss and costlier credit, the typical day still kept ₹179 per quintal.

scenes.headline: A trader who only knew the morning's news
scenes.caption: Using only the latest available Aroor report, the rule selects 19 of 19 modeled shipping days. 19 had positive modeled net, averaging ₹297 per quintal (₹185 under stress).

scenes.headline: The back-test
scenes.caption: The modeled Cabbage route from Kondotty to Aroor was positive on 100% of matched days in January 2021. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹29,700, or ₹18,500 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.

assumptions.value: onion survey freight applied per quintal to cabbage
scaled by road km against the 1,115 km Lasalgaon→Azadpur route → ₹38/qtl here
12% a year (14% adverse) for transit + 7 days
~450 road km a day → 1 days here

conclusion: The modeled Cabbage route from Kondotty to Aroor was positive on 100% of matched days in January 2021. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹29,700, or ₹18,500 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.

title: Cabbage: modeled ₹236/qtl left, Ladwa → Una
summary: December 2021: reported cabbage prices at Ladwa and Una imply a positive modeled margin after costs on 89% of 19 matched days; a morning-report back-test averages ₹236 per quintal. No actual trade verified.
why_selected: Selected from 922 same-variety market pairs screened for cabbage in December 2021; best tested candidate among the bounded set of routed finalists, not a global optimum.

evidence.observations: daily modal prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) at both markets; sale matched to the first Una report 1–3 days after purchase
caveats: Back-test on reported prices: no actual shipment, buyer or seller is claimed.
Modal prices are reported daily aggregates, not offers anyone could be sure to get.
This data has no arrival volumes, so it cannot show whether the destination could absorb more supply; no capital-constrained or volume allocation optimum is claimed.

Costs extrapolate onion survey values (including to other crops) plus stated allowances, not freight quotes; OSRM car routing, not a verified truck route. Representative town points may not be at mandi gates.
Historical: this says what paid then, not what pays today.

scenes.headline: December 2021
scenes.caption: Ladwa (Haryana) and Una (Himachal Pradesh) both reported cabbage prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) on 19 matched days.

scenes.headline: Two markets, two prices
scenes.caption: Ladwa reported a median ₹1,200 per quintal. Una reported a median ₹1,800 around modeled arrival days. These are not offers.

scenes.headline: Gap ₹400/qtl
scenes.caption: The median gap was ₹400 per quintal, and Una was dearer on 95% of days.

scenes.headline: 232 km by road
scenes.caption: 232 km on OpenStreetMap roads (~3 hours by car). A loaded truck is slower, so we allow 1 days plus 7 days to get paid.

scenes.headline: After modeled costs
scenes.caption: Freight ≈₹50/qtl, 5% fees and commission, loading, 5% loss and interest. On the typical day ₹198 per quintal was left.

scenes.headline: Still positive under stress
scenes.caption: With 25% dearer freight, 10% loss and costlier credit, the typical day still kept ₹104 per quintal.

scenes.headline: A trader who only knew the morning's news
scenes.caption: Using only the latest available Una report, the rule selects 15 of 19 modeled shipping days. 15 had positive modeled net, averaging ₹236 per quintal (₹137 under stress).

scenes.headline: The back-test
scenes.caption: The modeled Cabbage route from Ladwa to Una was positive on 89% of matched days in December 2021. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹23,600, or ₹13,700 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.

assumptions.value: onion survey freight applied per quintal to cabbage
scaled by road km against the 1,115 km Lasalgaon→Azadpur route → ₹50/qtl here
12% a year (14% adverse) for transit + 7 days
~450 road km a day → 1 days here

conclusion: The modeled Cabbage route from Ladwa to Una was positive on 89% of matched days in December 2021. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹23,600, or ₹13,700 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.
